about: Stage 7's data (tools/body/correctives.py). keys: [motion, absolute deg] posed as the check poses them (bends.Strip; hip_abd: the hip turned about her front). Regions: spheres round the joint's rest head, full within r_in, none past r_out (m). pull: the reference curves (tools/body/ref) the outline is pulled to (the joint's own anatomy: olecranon, patella plane, deltoid cap, folds); cap: the farthest an outline point is pulled (m); outline: that term's weight multiplier.
